extraction_scope.per_frame: one output frame per recorded body.events item, same order and observed_at; no interpolation
extraction_scope.request_fields: state, Kueue reason category, gpu count, priority, submitted_at, pod rank/node alias/state/exit codes/phase and phase time/barrier worker count/compute correctness, gang pod count, admitted pod count, QuotaReserved/Admitted/Finished times
extraction_scope.aliases: nodes → GPU-A..C, checked against the recorded CUDA model of each published alias; requests → R01..R10; each request is one native Job → Rnn·a1 (no retries recorded)
extraction_scope.derived: elapsed_seconds from observed_at; priority_changes is empty because every recorded priority is 0
extraction_scope.replaced: event titles mapped to fixed templates; Kueue admission messages mapped to categories
